verdict.rationale: A long-time customer reports running dozens of purpose-named accounts with auto-funding rules, which points to a native auto top-up feature, but no first-party documentation describes it. Low-balance alerts are not documented as a product feature. Account-balance-change webhooks and the internal-transfer API are only developer building blocks that would let someone build such automation, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party docs for auto-transfer/top-up rules, a native low-balance alert feature, configurable thresholds, and corroboration beyond one community comment.
